title: snake_case and camelCase
hints: For snake_to_camel: split on '_', throw away empty pieces, lowercase everything, then capitalize every word except the first and join.
str.capitalize() uppercases the first character and lowercases the rest; that is the per-word rule you want.
For camel_to_snake use re.sub with a backreference: re.sub(r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])", r"\1_\2", name).lower() handles everything except acronyms.
Acronyms need one more substitution first: re.sub(r"([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])", r"\1_\2", name) turns 'HTTPSProxy' into 'HTTPS_Proxy'.
